title: aprender KMeans has no n_init restarts: vs sklearn KMeans(n_init=10) inertia is worse at 28/29 k and ARI at the chosen k=12 is 0.24
evidence: E9 parity run 2026-09-25 on 191 unclaimed-issue docs (TF-IDF, seed 42, max_iter 300, tol 1e-4). TfidfVectorizer: same vocab set, max |dX| 5.0e-10, so the input is identical. KMeans inertia k=2..30: aprender > sklearn n_init=10 at 28/29 k (max +1.76%, k=12 +1.29%); aprender < sklearn n_init=1 at 15/29, i.e. single-init parity, not an update-step defect. ARI(ap, sk_n10) at k=12 = 0.238, and sklearn's own n_init=1 vs n_init=10 ARI = 0.260. crates/aprender-core/src/cluster/kmeans_impl.rs exposes with_max_iter/with_tol/with_random_state only. Artifacts /mnt/nvme-raid0/tmp/5d-clusters/e9/compare.json + crates/aprender-core/examples/e9_unclaimed_kmeans.rs (worktree aprender-wt-5d-e9, uncommitted).
repro: Fit KMeans::new(k).with_random_state(42) and sklearn KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10) on the same dense TF-IDF matrix for k in 2..30 and compare inertia_ and adjusted_rand_score. Fix direction: add with_n_init(n) (best-of-n by inertia, default 1 to preserve outputs) + a parity test vs a pinned sklearn fixture.
suspected_epic: none (aprender-core cluster; sklearn-parity) - cop to route
